title: Review of c52's selection by protection on fresh seed 24: the hunting kind's material rises to 4.7-6.2x the other's while the conversion-everywhere control stays near 1.2; the non-hunting kind holds no bodies in either arm
summary: Labkit runs of world2m.py, 128^2, t=12000, seed 24: selective arm (chiF 0 for kind b, chiFe 0.5 for e, gate 1, mconv 1e-3) and the conversion-everywhere control (same with gate 0). Ratio of mean rendered e to b material (render channels, clipped at 0) at t=3000 / 4500 / 5900 / 9000 / 12000: selective 2.74 / 4.71 / 5.63 / 6.22 / 4.71; gate 0 1.20 / 1.28 / 1.25 / 1.22 / 1.16. Kind-b bodies 0 at every sampled time in both arms; kind-e bodies 37-51 (selective) and 35-43 (gate 0).

observations.H: sel/ vs nogate/ (seed 24): e/b material 4.7-6.2 from t=4500 with the solution-only interconversion against 1.16-1.28 when conversion acts everywhere

seeds_run.result: pass: selective e/b 4.71 at t=12000 (finding 2.65-3.65, plateau 3.5-4.7); gate-0 control 1.16 (finding 1.000)

controls_run.H: gate 0 (conversion everywhere) on the same seed in nogate/

verdicts.limitation: I measured the ratio from labkit's rendered fields (concentrations clipped at 0), not the world's own totals, which is probably why my gate-0 control reads 1.16-1.28 rather than exactly 1.00. No neutral arm on my seed. The kinds are two fixed species with a written taxis difference and a kind-blind interconversion; selection here is the protection of condensed material, not births and deaths of individuals.
